info.title: API.SH: Barchart
info.description: The Barchart API from API.SH: public Barchart data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An ETF's holdings by weight: symbol, name, percent of the fund, shares held and last price, with the total count.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/barchart-etf-holdings

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Daily or intraday (1 to 240 minute) bars: time, open, high, low, close, change, percent change and volume, for stocks, ETFs, indexes, futures, currencies and crypto. Page by date: pass `next_to` back as `to` (newest first) or `next_from` back as `from` (oldest first); null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/barchart-history

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Barchart symbol, e.g. `AAPL`, `SPY`, `ZCZ26` (futures), `^BTCUSD`, `$SPX` (or a barchart.com quote link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Calls and puts for one expiration: strike, bid, mid, ask, last, change, volume, open interest and its change, implied volatility, delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho, moneyness, days to expiration; plus the underlying price and every expiration date.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/barchart-options

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Barchart symbol, e.g. `AAPL`, `SPY`, `ZCZ26` (futures), `^BTCUSD`, `$SPX` (or a barchart.com quote link).

parameters.name: moneyness
parameters.description: In or out of the money (default all).

parameters.name: strikes_near
parameters.description: Keep only the N strikes nearest the underlying price.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Quotes for up to 25 stocks, ETFs, funds, indexes, futures, currencies or crypto: price, change, open/high/low, previous close, volume, bid/ask, 52-week range and dates, performance (5 days to 1 year), weighted alpha, market cap, P/E, EPS, beta, dividend, next earnings date, margins and ratios, analyst targets and mean recommendation, Barchart opinion (overall, short, medium, long term) and Trend Seeker signal, moving averages, RSI, stochastic, volatility, ATR, CEO, website, employees and address. Numbers come parsed; the site's display text is kept as `*_display`. `fields` adds any other Barchart field name.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/barchart-quote

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
